prompts.title: Peaceful Moment with Music in a Hilly Landscape
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic cinematic outdoor portrait of a stylish man sitting casually on a lush green meadow covered with tiny white wildflowers, surrounded by rolling green hills and distant mountains.
He has naturally, slightly tousled hair, and wears dark black rectangular sunglasses and large black over-ear wireless headphones. He is dressed in a black vertically textured button-down shirt with the sleeves casually rolled up to the forearms, relaxed-fit cream trousers , and clean white  sneakers.
Pose: He sits naturally on the grass in a relaxed, thoughtful posture. One knee is raised and bent toward the camera while the other leg extends comfortably forward. Both hands rests casually on his raised knee. His head is tilted slightly upward and to the side, creating a calm, introspective expression.
Background: Beautiful expansive green rolling hills with soft distant mountains, gently blurred for depth. The foreground is filled with lush grass and small white flowers.
Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight coming from the upper left/back side, creating soft highlights along his hair, face, shoulders, and clothing, with natural shadows and subtle rim lighting. Warm sunlight gently illuminates the meadow and hills.
Camera: Eye-level to slightly low perspective, medium-full body composition, subject prominently framed while keeping the scenic landscape visible. 85mm portrait lens, f/1.6, shallow depth of field, creamy background bokeh, realistic perspective.
Style: Ultra-realistic luxury lifestyle photography, cinematic color grading, ultra-detailed skin texture, highly detailed fabric and hair, realistic sunlight, realistic reflections in sunglasses, premium editorial aesthetic, crisp subject details, soft atmospheric depth, 8K photorealism, aspect ratio 4:5 composition.
Face matching: using a reference face, preserve the face with maximum identity accuracy. Do not alter facial structure, proportions or distinctive facial features. No beautification or facial reshaping.
Negative prompt: artificial skin, distorted anatomy, unnatural hands, blurry face, warped sunglasses, deformed headphones, bad proportions, harsh shadows, overexposure, underexposure, low resolution, watermark, text, cropped feet, cropped legs, artificial background.

prompts.title: Monochrome Headphone Profile
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for face and identity reference. Preserve the person’s natural facial features and overall identity with high accuracy.

Create an ultra-realistic, high-contrast, black-and-white, low-key studio portrait of the reference subject in a quiet moment of musical immersion.

Composition & Framing
Use a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Show the subject in a strict 90-degree right-facing side profile, framed as a lower-chest-up / mid-torso portrait. Keep the subject centered overall, but make him appear smaller in frame, as if photographed from a little farther away.

Leave generous negative space above the head, clearly more headroom than in a typical tight portrait. Also keep moderate open space in front of the face on the right. Make sure the full hair shape, headphones, hood, shoulder, and upper torso are comfortably visible. Do not crop too close.
Pose & Expression
Keep the head in a clean right-facing profile with the chin slightly raised. Eyes gently closed, brow completely relaxed, lips softly and naturally rested together, jaw loose, and facial muscles calm. The expression should feel quiet, immersed, serene, and meditative, not pouty, tense, dramatic, or fashion-posed.

Wardrobe & Headphones
The subject wears premium over-ear wireless headphones with a smooth wide headband, thick matte ear cushions, and large circular metallic ear cups with a clear brushed / spun metal texture.

He wears a white hoodie. The hoodie should look smooth, plain, soft, and clean, with no visible fabric texture. Avoid rough weave or strong cloth grain. The hood rests naturally around the upper back and neck, creating a thick layered collar, with one flat drawstring hanging naturally down the chest.
Lighting
Use dramatic low-key chiaroscuro studio lighting that closely matches the original image.

The main light is a strong hard rim light placed behind and slightly above the subject on the right side. This rim light should create a crisp silver outline along:

the outer hair silhouette

the forehead, nose bridge, lips, and chin edge

the outer metallic edge of the headphone cup

the hoodie collar, shoulder ridge, and upper sleeve
Add only a very weak, highly diffused front-left fill light so the face and hoodie remain visible without becoming flat or bright. The fill should be extremely subtle. Keep the shadows deep and moody. The face should not look evenly lit or front-lit. The original image’s lighting should feel more like a sculpted edge-lit portrait than a standard soft studio portrait.

Background
Use a pure seamless black background with no visible texture, no environment, and no extra elements.

Camera & Detail
Simulate a portrait telephoto lens (85mm–105mm) with f/5.6 to f/8 depth of field so the entire subject stays sharp — including hair texture, skin detail, headphones, hoodie shape, and drawstring. Keep the image crisp and realistic, but do not over-emphasize fabric texture.

Important Constraints
Keep more negative space above the head
Make the subject appear farther from the camera
Keep the subject centered overall
Chin slightly raised
Expression must be soft, calm, and meditative
Lighting must stay dark, sculpted, and rim-light dominant
Do not make the face too bright or too evenly lit
Hoodie must remain smooth and plain without any texture
Do not make it a tight crop
Do not rotate the face toward the camera
Do not add text, logos, watermark, or extra objects

prompts.title: The Modern Listener
prompts.prompt:
Create a sleek, modern forced-perspective portrait of a male standing on top of a gigantic smartphone screen, with extreme scale contrast. The phone dominates the environment, and the subject appears life-size and physically grounded on its surface.

Subject
Male with natural dark hair, well-groomed.

Expression
Neutral, calm, confident. Looking directly upward at the camera.

Outfit
Oversized premium white hoodie (natural folds, soft drape), relaxed black shorts, clean white crew socks, white Air Jordan sneakers, metallic silver over-ear headphones (AirPods Max style).

Pose (LOCK)
Standing naturally, body slightly angled left (~10–15°).
Head tilted upward toward camera.
Both hands inside shorts pockets.
Weight evenly balanced. Grounded, realistic stance.
No exaggerated posing.

Scale (CRITICAL LOCK)
Phone occupies 85–90% of the lower frame area (the Phone's upper side on the left, the lower side on the lower right).
Subject occupies ~65–75% of frame height.
Full body visible (no cropping).
Subject must feel life-size relative to phone surface.
Feet firmly planted with realistic contact shadow.
No floating or miniature effect.

Camera (HARD LOCK)
Strict top-down high angle (70–80° overhead).
Camera nearly vertical — not diagonal or cinematic.
Flattened perspective like real top-shot photography.
Phone edges clearly visible in perspective (not flat front view).

Environment & Device
Giant black iPhone, minimal modern design.
iPhone head on left side in the frame.
Screen displays Spotify dark UI with album art interface featuring the song "Sun is Coming" by Sajanka, complete with album artwork depicting a stylized sunset and a human silhouette.
UI elements subtle, realistic, not distracting.
Phone placed on seamless light grey-white studio surface.

Background
Infinite seamless light grey-white studio sweep.
No horizon, no edges, no walls, no textures.
Clean, minimal, distraction-free.
Soft gradient falloff for depth.

Lighting
Soft high-key studio lighting from above.
Clean, diffused shadows.
Subtle ambient shadow under phone.
Realistic drop shadow from subject onto glowing screen.

Rendering Style
Ultra photorealistic (no AI look).
Natural skin texture (visible pores, no smoothing).
Accurate fabric physics (hoodie folds important).
Clean edges, no halo or cutout artifacts.

Lens & Technical
28–35mm lens (slightly wide for scale exaggeration).
f/2.8, mostly sharp focus.
High detail, 8K realism.

Aspect Ratio
4:5 vertical (composition built for this, no crop simulation).

Negative Prompt
no low angle, no eye-level shot, no cinematic tilt, no front view, no small phone, no tiny subject, no floating feet, no wrong perspective, no AI skin smoothing, no bad proportions
